Before using real payments

Published recipients, expense order, and shares will be fixed. Check them with your teammates first. This preview uses names only; it does not verify wallet addresses or collect anyone’s approval.

Expenses are paid in order. Unpaid expenses carry forward. Each payment’s smallest-unit rounding remainder goes to the final teammate. Network fees are separate.

No wallet signature. No real payments. This review is not a teammate’s approval.
